svg.aria-label: Trail patterns of four gaits, travelling left to right: walk as a zig-zag of single prints; trot as a straight narrow line; lope as groups of three or four prints in a slanting line with gaps; hare bound as groups of four with the two long hind prints ahead of the two front prints.

g.text: zig-zag; hind lands in or near front print (direct register)
straight, narrow line; longer, even steps
groups of 3–4 prints in a slant, long gaps
groups of 4: long hind prints land ahead of front prints
